text.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「AI SaaS 落地页」创作图像：强调产品价值、可信度与清晰转化路径的营销首页。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{product_name}}`（产品名称）：内部主题使用“AI SaaS 落地页”；封面不渲染无法保证准确的长文字，仅保留清晰标题安全区
- `{{core_benefit}}`（核心价值）：强调产品价值、可信度与清晰转化路径的营销首页。

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 如需求包含文字，只渲染需求中给出的短文案；不要虚构口号、品牌名或长段填充文本。

## 成品结构
- 按完整产品界面处理：建立明确栅格、一个主行动按钮、可理解的组件状态与可信的信息密度。仅在需求明确时选择桌面端 16:9 或移动端 9:16。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Design a high-converting SaaS landing page for {{product_name}}. The hero must communicate {{core_benefit}} with a clear headline, one primary call to action, a believable product preview, three concise benefit modules, and a customer-proof strip. Editorial grid, airy spacing, confident contemporary typography, no real brand logos, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{product_name}}` (Product Name): Internal theme: “AI SaaS Landing Page”; the cover avoids unreliable long readable copy and preserves a clear title-safe zone
- `{{core_benefit}}` (Core Benefit): The central action or outcome defined by AI SaaS Landing Page, staged as one immediately readable visual beat
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- If text is requested, render only the exact short copy supplied in the brief. Do not invent slogans, brand names, or long filler paragraphs.

### Deliverable requirements
- Use a coherent product screen with a deliberate grid, one primary action, clear component states, and a realistic content density. Select 16:9 for desktop or 9:16 for mobile only when the brief specifies that platform.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

text.en:
Create one vertical character-card key visual for an original {{character_archetype}}. Build her identity around {{appearance_anchors}} and the repeatable silhouette of {{signature_weapon}}. Use a three-quarter portrait with a crisp, expressive face, natural anatomy, layered costume construction, and restrained motion in hair or fabric. Let {{faction_palette}} guide the armor accents, atmospheric backdrop, and one controlled rim light; render in {{render_style}}. Reserve a clean title-safe zone while keeping the image readable as a small card. No alternate costumes, no extra characters, no existing IP, no readable text, no logo, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{character_archetype}}` (Character Archetype): A young oriental-fantasy swordswoman; calm
- `{{appearance_anchors}}` (Appearance Anchors): Young East Asian woman
- `{{signature_weapon}}` (Signature Weapon): A slender luminous longsword made of jade and steel
- `{{faction_palette}}` (Faction Palette): Ink black and ivory as primary colors
- `{{render_style}}` (Render Style): Vertical 2:3 cinematic oriental-fantasy game concept art with realistic-anime character rendering and detailed fabric and metal.
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Keep anatomy, hands, wardrobe logic, and character-defining features consistent. Direct pose, expression, lens perspective, and background so they all support one identity.
- Make the AI-assisted creative workflow concrete: identify the human decision, the AI step, the input artifact, the review point, and the usable output. Use honest capability boundaries, controlled information hierarchy, and product-realistic interaction states; do not imply unsupported automation, fabricated metrics, or autonomous claims.
- Make the chosen medium visible in mark-making, texture, depth, and edge treatment. Use a restrained palette and a single focal hierarchy rather than an undirected style collage.
- For a series, lock the subject proportions, palette roles, lens language, and layout grammar before varying scene content. Every variation must remain recognizably in the same system.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review character continuity before production use.

text.en:
Create one premium vertical collectible weapon-card key visual for an original {{weapon_type}}. Make {{material_language}} physically believable through accurate construction, wear, reflection, edge treatment, and a stable silhouette. Visualize {{energy_mechanism}} as a precise, contained effect that follows the weapon's geometry rather than random particles. Add {{faction_symbol}} as a subtle engraved or structural motif, not readable branding. Render in {{presentation_style}} with the weapon as the single hero, a dark atmospheric backing, dramatic controlled lighting, and a clean title-safe zone. No character holding the weapon, no duplicate weapon, no existing IP, no readable text, no logo, no watermark.

text.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「AIGC 动漫角色肖像」创作图像：为原创动漫角色生成脸部识别稳定、气质明确、可作为系列视觉锚点的近景肖像。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{character_description}}`（角色描述）：年轻东方女性天空法师，深色长发高束、蓝紫色清晰眼睛、精致金属发饰
- `{{emotion}}`（情绪）：平静、自信、略带神秘感的直接凝视
- `{{wardrobe}}`（服装）：半透明午夜蓝高领长外套，细金线刺绣、垂坠耳饰与轻薄飘带
- `{{background_tone}}`（背景色调）：雨夜高层城市，蓝紫霓虹虚化、湿润空气与漂浮金色符纸
- `{{visual_style}}`（视觉风格）：竖版 2:3 高完成度现代动漫肖像，精细线稿、柔和赛璐璐阴影与电影级氛围光

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 将 AI 辅助创作工作流做具体：明确人的决策、AI 步骤、输入素材、审核节点和可用输出；使用诚实的能力边界、受控的信息层级和可信产品状态，不得暗示不具备的自动化能力、虚构数据或自治主张。
- 让媒介特征体现在笔触、纹理、深度和边缘处理上；使用克制色板与单一焦点，不做无方向的风格拼贴。
- 系列工作流先锁定主体比例、色彩角色、镜头语言与版式语法，再变化场景内容；每张图都必须属于同一视觉系统。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Create a polished original anime character portrait of {{character_description}} with a {{emotion}} expression. Use a chest-up crop, readable eyes, stable face proportions, and {{wardrobe}} as a repeatable identity anchor. Set the character against a simplified {{background_tone}} environment and render in {{visual_style}} with deliberate line quality, layered hair, subtle material shading, and one clear directional light. The image must be specific enough to guide later scenes while still working as a standalone promotion visual. No existing anime character likeness, no extra characters, no text, no logo, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{character_description}}` (Character Description): A young East Asian sky mage with long dark hair in a high updo
- `{{emotion}}` (Emotion): A calm
- `{{wardrobe}}` (Wardrobe): A translucent midnight-blue high-collar coat with fine gold embroidery
- `{{background_tone}}` (Background Tone): A rainy elevated city at night with blue-violet neon bokeh
- `{{visual_style}}` (Visual Style): Vertical 2:3 premium contemporary anime portrait with refined linework
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Make the AI-assisted creative workflow concrete: identify the human decision, the AI step, the input artifact, the review point, and the usable output. Use honest capability boundaries, controlled information hierarchy, and product-realistic interaction states; do not imply unsupported automation, fabricated metrics, or autonomous claims.
- Make the chosen medium visible in mark-making, texture, depth, and edge treatment. Use a restrained palette and a single focal hierarchy rather than an undirected style collage.
- For a series, lock the subject proportions, palette roles, lens language, and layout grammar before varying scene content. Every variation must remain recognizably in the same system.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「专注习惯移动应用」创作图像：以单一任务和温和进度反馈为核心的移动端界面。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{app_name}}`（应用名称）：内部主题使用“专注习惯移动应用”；封面不渲染无法保证准确的长文字，仅保留清晰标题安全区
- `{{daily_goal}}`（每日目标）：以单一任务和温和进度反馈为核心的移动端界面。

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 如需求包含文字，只渲染需求中给出的短文案；不要虚构口号、品牌名或长段填充文本。

## 成品结构
- 按完整产品界面处理：建立明确栅格、一个主行动按钮、可理解的组件状态与可信的信息密度。仅在需求明确时选择桌面端 16:9 或移动端 9:16。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Create a calm mobile app home screen for {{app_name}}, centered on a single daily focus session and the goal {{daily_goal}}. Include an elegant circular progress control, one primary action, a minimal habit streak, and a small weekly history. Soft warm background, tactile cards, highly legible mobile UI, no device frame, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{app_name}}` (App Name): Internal theme: “Focus Mobile App”; the cover avoids unreliable long readable copy and preserves a clear title-safe zone
- `{{daily_goal}}` (Daily Goal): The central action or outcome defined by Focus Mobile App, staged as one immediately readable visual beat
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- If text is requested, render only the exact short copy supplied in the brief. Do not invent slogans, brand names, or long filler paragraphs.

### Deliverable requirements
- Use a coherent product screen with a deliberate grid, one primary action, clear component states, and a realistic content density. Select 16:9 for desktop or 9:16 for mobile only when the brief specifies that platform.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务

## 必填需求字段
- `{{character_description}}`（角色描述）：主播情绪头像封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕头像与表情、主播头像、情绪表达建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{wardrobe}}`（服装）：主播情绪头像封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕头像与表情、主播头像、情绪表达建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{expression}}`（表情）：以“主播情绪头像”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：为直播、短视频与社群活动生成情绪清晰、识别稳定的角色化头像。
- `{{accent_color}}`（强调颜色）：自然肤色与中性服装色为主，背景使用低饱和冷色，轮廓光采用柔和暖色
- `{{visual_style}}`（视觉风格）：插画表现，围绕头像与表情、主播头像、情绪表达建立高完成度、单一焦点和清晰层级

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。

- 系列工作流先锁定主体比例、色彩角色、镜头语言与版式语法，再变化场景内容；每张图都必须属于同一视觉系统。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。

- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Create a high-fidelity illustrated avatar of {{character_description}} for a creator profile. Use a close head-and-shoulders crop, direct readable eyes, and a clearly recognizable {{expression}}. Lock {{wardrobe}} as a repeatable identity anchor and use {{accent_color}} only as a controlled edge or background accent. Render in {{visual_style}} with clean facial construction, consistent line weight, soft dimensional shading, and a simple shape behind the head that still reads at 96px. No full body, no exaggerated facial distortion, no dense UI frame, no text, no logo, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{character_description}}` (Character Description): The main subject of the Streamer Expression Avatar cover, with identity and appearance anchored to Avatar Expression and stable face, hair, wardrobe, and pose cues
- `{{wardrobe}}` (Wardrobe): The main subject of the Streamer Expression Avatar cover, with identity and appearance anchored to Avatar Expression and stable face, hair, wardrobe, and pose cues
- `{{expression}}` (Expression): Concrete value: Streamer Expression Avatar; the visual directly delivers the case summary and expression role
- `{{accent_color}}` (Accent Color): Natural skin tones and neutral wardrobe colors, with a muted cool background and soft warm rim light
- `{{visual_style}}` (Visual Style): Illustration treatment focused on Avatar Expression, with polished execution, one focal point, and clear hierarchy
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Make face identity, eye direction, expression, hairstyle, and crop unambiguous at small avatar size. Preserve natural facial structure and consistent color treatment; for an expression pack, vary only the requested emotion and keep the same face, wardrobe, lighting, camera angle, and background across every tile.
- For a series, lock the subject proportions, palette roles, lens language, and layout grammar before varying scene content. Every variation must remain recognizably in the same system.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「创意工作室东方女性特写」创作图像：以干净现代的工作室光线呈现自信东方女性近景，适合职业与创意人物视觉。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{subject_description}}`（主体描述）：以“创意工作室东方女性特写”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：以干净现代的工作室光线呈现自信东方女性近景，适合职业与创意人物视觉。
- `{{wardrobe}}`（服装）：创意工作室东方女性特写封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕摄影、东方女性、人像特写建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{backdrop_color}}`（背景颜色）：自然肤色与中性服装色为主，背景使用低饱和冷色，轮廓光采用柔和暖色

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。

## 成品结构
- 保持人体、手部、服装逻辑与角色识别特征一致；姿势、表情、镜头和背景都必须服务同一身份。
- 固定为头肩或胸像近景：脸部约占画面 60–75%，双眼必须清晰对焦，保留自然皮肤纹理；不得出现全身、远景、遮挡脸部的手势、过度磨皮或变形五官。

text.en:
Create a polished, photorealistic studio close-up of {{subject_description}}, a confident East Asian woman. Compose a vertical head-and-shoulders portrait with the face filling two-thirds of the frame; both eyes, lashes, and irises are in precise focus. The subject wears {{wardrobe}} against a minimal {{backdrop_color}} studio backdrop. Use a soft 45-degree key light, subtle fill, and a slight rim highlight to create definition without hard glamour lighting. Preserve natural pores, fine baby hairs, believable skin tone variation, and an intelligent relaxed expression. Camera: 105mm lens at f/3.2, medium-format editorial portrait photography, accurate neutral color. No full body, no crop below upper chest, no hands in frame, no plastic skin, no exaggerated contour makeup, no distorted features, no readable text, no logo, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{subject_description}}` (Subject Description): Concrete value: East Asian Creative Closeup; the visual directly delivers the case summary and subject description role
- `{{wardrobe}}` (Wardrobe): The main subject of the East Asian Creative Closeup cover, with identity and appearance anchored to Portrait Character and stable face, hair, wardrobe, and pose cues
- `{{backdrop_color}}` (Backdrop Color): Natural skin tones and neutral wardrobe colors, with a muted cool background and soft warm rim light
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Keep anatomy, hands, wardrobe logic, and character-defining features consistent. Direct pose, expression, lens perspective, and background so they all support one identity.
- Use a head-and-shoulders or upper-chest close-up only: let the face occupy roughly 60–75% of the frame, keep both eyes sharply focused, preserve natural skin texture, and exclude full-body framing, distant views, obscuring hands, heavy beauty retouching, and warped facial features.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

text.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「商品透明背景抠图」创作图像：为电商与设计合成提取干净完整的商品主体。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{product_description}}`（产品描述）：商品透明背景抠图封面中的单一主对象；保持完整轮廓、可信比例、主体采用可辨认的真实材质与精确边缘，表面同时保留柔和漫反射、受控高光和自然接触阴影
- `{{edge_detail}}`（边缘细节）：以“商品透明背景抠图”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：为电商与设计合成提取干净完整的商品主体。

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 保持商品几何、材质和尺度可信；商品必须是唯一焦点，用可控布光、接触阴影和文案留白替代无关道具。
- 保持人体、手部、服装逻辑与角色识别特征一致；姿势、表情、镜头和背景都必须服务同一身份。
- 编辑工作流只改动指定区域或属性；保留未改动主体、透视、机位、光向、阴影、纹理和颗粒，不能引入无关对象。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Extract {{product_description}} onto a genuinely transparent background. Preserve all {{edge_detail}}, fine material details, natural silhouette, and original proportions. Remove every background pixel and cast shadow unless the product itself includes it. No text, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{product_description}}` (Product Description): The single hero object in the Product Cutout Transparency cover, preserving its complete silhouette, credible proportions, and the hero object uses recognizable real materials, precise edges, soft diffuse response, controlled highlights, and a natural contact shadow
- `{{edge_detail}}` (Edge Detail): Concrete value: Product Cutout Transparency; the visual directly delivers the case summary and edge detail role
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Preserve product geometry, material, and believable scale. Make the product the unambiguous hero; support it with controlled lighting, contact shadow, and copy-safe space rather than unrelated props.
- Keep anatomy, hands, wardrobe logic, and character-defining features consistent. Direct pose, expression, lens perspective, and background so they all support one identity.
- For edit workflows, change only the requested region or attribute. Preserve untouched subjects, perspective, camera angle, lighting direction, shadows, texture, and grain. Do not introduce unrelated objects.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

text.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「夜景霓虹东方女性特写」创作图像：以克制霓虹反射拍摄时髦真实的东方女性夜景近景，确保面部轮廓和双眼始终清晰。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{subject_description}}`（主体描述）：以“夜景霓虹东方女性特写”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：以克制霓虹反射拍摄时髦真实的东方女性夜景近景，确保面部轮廓和双眼始终清晰。
- `{{wardrobe}}`（服装）：夜景霓虹东方女性特写封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕摄影、东方女性、人像特写建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{neon_palette}}`（霓虹色板）：自然肤色与中性服装色为主，背景使用低饱和冷色，轮廓光采用柔和暖色

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 保持人体、手部、服装逻辑与角色识别特征一致；姿势、表情、镜头和背景都必须服务同一身份。
- 固定为头肩或胸像近景：脸部约占画面 60–75%，双眼必须清晰对焦，保留自然皮肤纹理；不得出现全身、远景、遮挡脸部的手势、过度磨皮或变形五官。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Create a stylish but photorealistic night close-up of {{subject_description}}, an East Asian woman. Frame only the upper chest, neck, and head, with the face filling 68% of the vertical image and both eyes sharply focused. The subject wears {{wardrobe}}. Use a soft neutral key light to preserve true skin color, then add only subtle {{neon_palette}} reflections along the far cheek and hair edge. Keep the city background as dark, clean bokeh with no readable signage. Preserve pores, soft natural hair texture, a composed direct expression, and plausible low-light shadows. Shot on an 85mm lens at f/1.8, cinematic editorial photography, balanced exposure. No full body, no heavy cyberpunk styling, no neon bloom across the face, no sunglasses, no hands near face, no plastic skin, no facial distortion, no text, no logo, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{subject_description}}` (Subject Description): Concrete value: East Asian Neon Closeup; the visual directly delivers the case summary and subject description role
- `{{wardrobe}}` (Wardrobe): The main subject of the East Asian Neon Closeup cover, with identity and appearance anchored to Portrait Character and stable face, hair, wardrobe, and pose cues
- `{{neon_palette}}` (Neon Palette): Natural skin tones and neutral wardrobe colors, with a muted cool background and soft warm rim light
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Keep anatomy, hands, wardrobe logic, and character-defining features consistent. Direct pose, expression, lens perspective, and background so they all support one identity.
- Use a head-and-shoulders or upper-chest close-up only: let the face occupy roughly 60–75% of the frame, keep both eyes sharply focused, preserve natural skin texture, and exclude full-body framing, distant views, obscuring hands, heavy beauty retouching, and warped facial features.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

text.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「室内家具替换」创作图像：替换指定家具并保持空间透视、比例和光线一致。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{existing_item}}`（现有物品）：室内家具替换封面中的单一主对象；保持完整轮廓、可信比例、主体采用可辨认的真实材质与精确边缘，表面同时保留柔和漫反射、受控高光和自然接触阴影
- `{{replacement_item}}`（替换物品）：室内家具替换封面中的单一主对象；保持完整轮廓、可信比例、主体采用可辨认的真实材质与精确边缘，表面同时保留柔和漫反射、受控高光和自然接触阴影

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 保持商品几何、材质和尺度可信；商品必须是唯一焦点，用可控布光、接触阴影和文案留白替代无关道具。
- 保持人体、手部、服装逻辑与角色识别特征一致；姿势、表情、镜头和背景都必须服务同一身份。
- 编辑工作流只改动指定区域或属性；保留未改动主体、透视、机位、光向、阴影、纹理和颗粒，不能引入无关对象。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Replace only {{existing_item}} with {{replacement_item}} in the interior. Keep the room architecture, viewpoint, camera lens feel, lighting, shadows, decor, and scale unchanged. Match the replacement’s material and contact points to the scene. No text, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{existing_item}}` (Existing Item): The single hero object in the Interior Furniture Replace cover, preserving its complete silhouette, credible proportions, and the hero object uses recognizable real materials, precise edges, soft diffuse response, controlled highlights, and a natural contact shadow
- `{{replacement_item}}` (Replacement Item): The single hero object in the Interior Furniture Replace cover, preserving its complete silhouette, credible proportions, and the hero object uses recognizable real materials, precise edges, soft diffuse response, controlled highlights, and a natural contact shadow
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Preserve product geometry, material, and believable scale. Make the product the unambiguous hero; support it with controlled lighting, contact shadow, and copy-safe space rather than unrelated props.
- Keep anatomy, hands, wardrobe logic, and character-defining features consistent. Direct pose, expression, lens perspective, and background so they all support one identity.
- For edit workflows, change only the requested region or attribute. Preserve untouched subjects, perspective, camera angle, lighting direction, shadows, texture, and grain. Do not introduce unrelated objects.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「年度报告封面」创作图像：面向企业发布场景的克制专业年度报告封面。

- `{{organization_type}}`（组织类型）：虚构且无商标的“年度报告封面”项目，品牌语气围绕出版设计、文档、编辑排版，不出现真实公司、Logo 或未经证实的主张
- `{{report_year}}`（报告年份）：采用与年度报告封面封面叙事一致的明确时间条件，并通过环境光、天气或版式信息体现，不添加无依据日期

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 如需求包含文字，只渲染需求中给出的短文案；不要虚构口号、品牌名或长段填充文本。

## 成品结构
- 建立一个主视觉或标题区、一个次级信息区与有意识的留白；缩略图状态下也必须先读出层级。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。

- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。

- `{{report_year}}` (Report Year): A defined time condition consistent with the Annual Report Cover cover, expressed through light, weather, or layout without inventing unsupported dates
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- If text is requested, render only the exact short copy supplied in the brief. Do not invent slogans, brand names, or long filler paragraphs.

### Deliverable requirements
- Establish one dominant visual or title zone, a secondary information zone, and intentional negative space. The composition must read at thumbnail size before adding detail.

### Quality gate

- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

## 必填需求字段
- `{{destination_style}}`（目的地风格）：矢量图形表现，围绕视觉图解、地图、流程设计建立高完成度、单一焦点和清晰层级
- `{{trip_length}}`（旅行长度）：采用与旅行行程规划板封面叙事一致的明确时间条件，并通过环境光、天气或版式信息体现，不添加无依据日期

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构

- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。

- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Make the reading path explicit: headline, 3–5 ordered modules, concise labels, and connectors whose direction and meaning are unambiguous. Do not substitute decorative illustration for information structure.

text.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「漫剧情绪冲突特写」创作图像：以近景眼神与克制光影承载对峙、误会或秘密揭露等高张力剧情节点。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{protagonist}}`（主角）：漫剧情绪冲突特写封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕漫剧、情绪冲突、人物特写建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{opposing_character}}`（对立角色）：漫剧情绪冲突特写封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕漫剧、情绪冲突、人物特写建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{conflict}}`（冲突）：以近景眼神与克制光影承载对峙、误会或秘密揭露等高张力剧情节点。
- `{{setting}}`（场景）：漫剧情绪冲突特写所示的完整环境；空间必须直接支撑“以近景眼神与克制光影承载对峙、误会或秘密揭露等高张力剧情节点。”并保留前景、中景和背景层次
- `{{lighting}}`（布光）：以“漫剧情绪冲突特写”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：以近景眼神与克制光影承载对峙、误会或秘密揭露等高张力剧情节点。

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 制作一张竖屏 9:16 的漫剧关键帧：情绪节点、主角和本集视觉钩子必须一眼可读；整个系列的人物设计、服装锚点、场景规则与光线连续。不得添加未要求的对白、字幕、平台界面或水印。
- 系列工作流先锁定主体比例、色彩角色、镜头语言与版式语法，再变化场景内容；每张图都必须属于同一视觉系统。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Create a vertical 9:16 comic-drama confrontation close-up. Show {{protagonist}} in sharp near-portrait focus reacting to {{conflict}} with {{opposing_character}} implied through a blurred shoulder, reflected silhouette, or controlled off-camera eyeline. Set the moment in {{setting}} and shape it with {{lighting}}. The face and eyes must carry the scene; preserve the protagonist's established hairstyle, costume anchors, and facial construction. Use restrained cinematic color separation, shallow depth, one intentional prop or background clue, and a clear lower-third area for optional post-production copy. No full body, no violence graphic detail, no speech bubbles, no excessive tears or effects, no text, no logo, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{protagonist}}` (Protagonist): The main subject of the Comic Drama Conflict Closeup cover, with identity and appearance anchored to Comic Drama and stable face, hair, wardrobe, and pose cues
- `{{opposing_character}}` (Opposing Character): The main subject of the Comic Drama Conflict Closeup cover, with identity and appearance anchored to Comic Drama and stable face, hair, wardrobe, and pose cues
- `{{conflict}}` (Conflict): The central action or outcome defined by Comic Drama Conflict Closeup, staged as one immediately readable visual beat
- `{{setting}}` (Setting): The complete environment shown in Comic Drama Conflict Closeup; it directly supports the case summary with readable foreground, midground, and background layers
- `{{lighting}}` (Lighting): Concrete value: Comic Drama Conflict Closeup; the visual directly delivers the case summary and lighting role
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Build one vertical 9:16 short-form drama keyframe with an immediately readable emotional beat, a clear protagonist, and one visual hook for the episode. Keep character design, costume anchors, setting rules, and lighting continuity stable across the series; do not add unrequested dialogue, subtitles, platform UI, or watermarks.
- For a series, lock the subject proportions, palette roles, lens language, and layout grammar before varying scene content. Every variation must remain recognizably in the same system.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「珍珠耳饰东方女性特写」创作图像：以柔和自然窗光拍摄优雅东方女性近景，突出清晰眼神、珍珠细节与真实肤质。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{subject_description}}`（主体描述）：以“珍珠耳饰东方女性特写”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：以柔和自然窗光拍摄优雅东方女性近景，突出清晰眼神、珍珠细节与真实肤质。
- `{{wardrobe}}`（服装）：珍珠耳饰东方女性特写封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕摄影、东方女性、人像特写建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{background_tone}}`（背景色调）：自然肤色与中性服装色为主，背景使用低饱和冷色，轮廓光采用柔和暖色

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 保持人体、手部、服装逻辑与角色识别特征一致；姿势、表情、镜头和背景都必须服务同一身份。
- 固定为头肩或胸像近景：脸部约占画面 60–75%，双眼必须清晰对焦，保留自然皮肤纹理；不得出现全身、远景、遮挡脸部的手势、过度磨皮或变形五官。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Create a photorealistic head-and-shoulders close-up portrait of {{subject_description}}, an elegant East Asian woman with a small pearl earring. Frame from upper chest to just above the head, with the face occupying about 70% of the image and both eyes perfectly sharp. The subject wears {{wardrobe}}. Use soft daylight from a large window, nuanced highlight on the pearl, natural skin pores, individual hair strands, refined but believable makeup, and a calm direct gaze. Keep the {{background_tone}} background softly blurred. Captured with an 85mm lens at f/2.2, premium editorial photography, natural color rendering. No full body, no beauty-filter skin, no oversized jewelry, no hand near the face, no facial distortion, no text, no logo, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{subject_description}}` (Subject Description): Concrete value: East Asian Pearls Closeup; the visual directly delivers the case summary and subject description role
- `{{wardrobe}}` (Wardrobe): The main subject of the East Asian Pearls Closeup cover, with identity and appearance anchored to Portrait Character and stable face, hair, wardrobe, and pose cues
- `{{background_tone}}` (Background Tone): Natural skin tones and neutral wardrobe colors, with a muted cool background and soft warm rim light
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Keep anatomy, hands, wardrobe logic, and character-defining features consistent. Direct pose, expression, lens perspective, and background so they all support one identity.
- Use a head-and-shoulders or upper-chest close-up only: let the face occupy roughly 60–75% of the frame, keep both eyes sharply focused, preserve natural skin texture, and exclude full-body framing, distant views, obscuring hands, heavy beauty retouching, and warped facial features.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「用户旅程地图」创作图像：通过触点、情绪和机会点描绘完整用户体验路径。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{service_type}}`（服务类型）：虚构且无商标的“用户旅程地图”项目，品牌语气围绕视觉图解、地图、流程设计，不出现真实公司、Logo 或未经证实的主张
- `{{user_goal}}`（用户目标）：视觉图解、地图、流程设计相关受众；核心关注点是通过触点、情绪和机会点描绘完整用户体验路径。

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 明确阅读路径：标题、3–5 个有顺序的模块、短标签与含义清晰的连接线。不能用装饰插画替代信息结构。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Design a customer journey map for {{service_type}} helping users achieve {{user_goal}}. Visualize stages, touchpoints, emotion curve, pain points, and opportunity zones. Clear service-design diagram, no readable text, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{service_type}}` (Service Type): A fictional unbranded Customer Journey Map project, positioned around Infographic, Educational Visual without real companies, logos, or unsupported claims
- `{{user_goal}}` (User Goal): An audience interested in Infographic, Educational Visual; the primary need is the use case described by Customer Journey Map
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Make the reading path explicit: headline, 3–5 ordered modules, concise labels, and connectors whose direction and meaning are unambiguous. Do not substitute decorative illustration for information structure.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「白皮书封面系统」创作图像：用理性图形与信息层级建立技术白皮书视觉系统。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{report_topic}}`（报告主题）：以“白皮书封面系统”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：用理性图形与信息层级建立技术白皮书视觉系统。
- `{{audience}}`（受众）：出版设计、文档、编辑排版相关受众；核心关注点是用理性图形与信息层级建立技术白皮书视觉系统。

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 如需求包含文字，只渲染需求中给出的短文案；不要虚构口号、品牌名或长段填充文本。

## 成品结构
- 建立一个主视觉或标题区、一个次级信息区与有意识的留白；缩略图状态下也必须先读出层级。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Design a technical whitepaper cover system for {{report_topic}} aimed at {{audience}}. Combine a precise abstract diagram, strong title hierarchy, issue metadata, and subtle grid logic. Trustworthy enterprise publishing design, no real logos, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{report_topic}}` (Report Topic): Concrete value: Whitepaper Cover System; the visual directly delivers the case summary and report topic role
- `{{audience}}` (Audience): An audience interested in Document Publishing; the primary need is the use case described by Whitepaper Cover System
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- If text is requested, render only the exact short copy supplied in the brief. Do not invent slogans, brand names, or long filler paragraphs.

### Deliverable requirements
- Establish one dominant visual or title zone, a secondary information zone, and intentional negative space. The composition must read at thumbnail size before adding detail.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

- `{{surface_family}}`（表面材质组）：黑曜石玻璃、烟晶树脂、氧化铜、浅色石灰岩、珠光陶瓷和炭黑水磨石六种原创建筑表面
- `{{sample_count}}`（样板数量）：固定六块等尺寸矩形样板，按两列三行排列，边距和间距一致，所有样板完整可见
- `{{material_contrast}}`（材质行为差异）：同时覆盖高反射、半透明、氧化粗糙、多孔哑光、珠光起伏和骨料颗粒六种不同表面行为
- `{{lighting_setup}}`（布光方案）：左上方大面积柔光提供基础亮度，右侧低角度掠射光专门揭示纹理深度，背景保持炭黑

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。

## 成品结构
- 透视、动线、光向、家具尺度和材质交界必须可信；加入必要的人尺度线索，但不要把空间做成拼贴式生活方式图。
- 让重复关系和材质行为可检查：明确母题尺度、边缘连续或样板数量、表面响应与目标承印材质；避免意外接缝、重复样板、不可制造浮雕和仅靠换色区分材质。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。

text.en:
Create one coherent architectural material study containing {{surface_family}}. Show {{sample_count}} with identical scale, edge radius, spacing, and camera perspective, while {{material_contrast}} remains physically distinct rather than color-only variation. Use {{lighting_setup}} to reveal reflectance, translucency, pores, relief, oxidation, and aggregate depth. Portrait 2:3 presentation, all samples fully visible, no labels, no hands, no room mockup, no duplicate materials, no logo, and no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{surface_family}}` (Surface Family): Six original architectural surfaces: obsidian glass, smoky quartz resin, oxidized copper, pale limestone, pearlescent ceramic, and charcoal terrazzo
- `{{sample_count}}` (Sample Count): Exactly six equal rectangular samples arranged in a two-column by three-row grid with consistent margins and every sample fully visible
- `{{material_contrast}}` (Material Contrast): Six distinct surface behaviors: reflective, translucent, oxidized rough, porous matte, pearlescent relief, and aggregate grain
- `{{lighting_setup}}` (Lighting Setup): A large soft source from upper left establishes exposure while a low grazing light from the right reveals texture depth against charcoal
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Keep perspective, circulation, light direction, furniture scale, and material transitions physically believable. Include human-scale cues without turning the space into a lifestyle collage.
- Make repetition and material behavior testable: define motif scale, edge continuity or sample count, surface response, and intended substrate. Avoid accidental seams, duplicate samples, unmanufacturable relief, and color-only material variation.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review material plausibility, sample count, and texture uniqueness before production use.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「社群活动宣传卡」创作图像：用友好且高辨识度的构图传播社群线下活动。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{event_type}}`（活动类型）：以“社群活动宣传卡”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：用友好且高辨识度的构图传播社群线下活动。
- `{{community_vibe}}`（社群氛围）：矢量图形与混合媒介表现，围绕社交媒体、营销内容、品牌传播建立高完成度、单一焦点和清晰层级

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 建立一个主视觉或标题区、一个次级信息区与有意识的留白；缩略图状态下也必须先读出层级。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:

## Production protocol

- `{{community_vibe}}` (Community Vibe): Vector Graphic and Mixed Media treatment focused on Poster Editorial, Brand Identity, with polished execution, one focal point, and clear hierarchy
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Establish one dominant visual or title zone, a secondary information zone, and intentional negative space. The composition must read at thumbnail size before adding detail.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

text.en:

The middle distance holds a small **{{settlement}}** that feels integrated into the landscape rather than pasted on top. In the far distance, layered mountains dissolve into atmospheric haze and one moon hangs above the horizon. Volumetric side light, believable material variation, quiet human scale, painterly production design, deep perspective, no text, no logos, no watermark.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「等距游戏场景」创作图像：展示可探索区域、地标与互动节奏的等距场景。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{biome}}`（生态环境）：等距游戏场景所示的完整环境；空间必须直接支撑“展示可探索区域、地标与互动节奏的等距场景。”并保留前景、中景和背景层次
- `{{landmark}}`（地标）：以“等距游戏场景”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：展示可探索区域、地标与互动节奏的等距场景。

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 保持人体、手部、服装逻辑与角色识别特征一致；姿势、表情、镜头和背景都必须服务同一身份。
- 通过前景、中景、远景和明确动作讲清叙事节点；系列中人物、道具和世界规则必须连续。
- 系列工作流先锁定主体比例、色彩角色、镜头语言与版式语法，再变化场景内容；每张图都必须属于同一视觉系统。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Create an original isometric game environment in {{biome}} featuring {{landmark}}. Include readable pathing, layered exploration points, tiny environmental storytelling, and coherent asset language. Stylized game art, no text, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{biome}}` (Biome): The complete environment shown in Isometric Game Environment; it directly supports the case summary with readable foreground, midground, and background layers
- `{{landmark}}` (Landmark): Concrete value: Isometric Game Environment; the visual directly delivers the case summary and landmark role
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Keep anatomy, hands, wardrobe logic, and character-defining features consistent. Direct pose, expression, lens perspective, and background so they all support one identity.
- Make the narrative beat legible through foreground, midground, background, and a clear focal action. Maintain continuity of subject, props, and world rules across any sequence.
- For a series, lock the subject proportions, palette roles, lens language, and layout grammar before varying scene content. Every variation must remain recognizably in the same system.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

text.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「统一表情包」创作图像：在同一角色和视觉规范下输出多种小尺寸情绪头像，方便聊天、直播和社群复用。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{character_description}}`（角色描述）：统一表情包封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕头像与表情、表情包、情绪系统建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{wardrobe}}`（服装）：统一表情包封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕头像与表情、表情包、情绪系统建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{expressions}}`（表情组）：以“统一表情包”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：在同一角色和视觉规范下输出多种小尺寸情绪头像，方便聊天、直播和社群复用。
- `{{visual_style}}`（视觉风格）：插画表现，围绕头像与表情、表情包、情绪系统建立高完成度、单一焦点和清晰层级
- `{{background_color}}`（背景颜色）：自然肤色与中性服装色为主，背景使用低饱和冷色，轮廓光采用柔和暖色

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 在小尺寸头像中让身份、眼神、表情、发型和裁切一眼可辨；保持自然五官结构与统一色彩。若需求是表情包，只变化指定情绪，所有格子必须保持同一张脸、服装、光线、机位和背景。
- 系列工作流先锁定主体比例、色彩角色、镜头语言与版式语法，再变化场景内容；每张图都必须属于同一视觉系统。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Create a clean 3-by-3 expression sticker sheet for {{character_description}}. Every tile uses the same head-and-shoulders crop, {{wardrobe}}, hairstyle, face proportions, camera angle, soft lighting, and {{background_color}} background. Vary only the nine requested {{expressions}}. Use {{visual_style}} with readable eyes, clear mouth shapes, generous margins around each head, thin consistent separators, and no visual clutter. Each expression must remain recognizable at small size. No full body, no pose changes, no extra characters, no text labels, no speech bubbles, no logo, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{character_description}}` (Character Description): The main subject of the Expression Sticker Pack cover, with identity and appearance anchored to Avatar Expression and stable face, hair, wardrobe, and pose cues
- `{{wardrobe}}` (Wardrobe): The main subject of the Expression Sticker Pack cover, with identity and appearance anchored to Avatar Expression and stable face, hair, wardrobe, and pose cues
- `{{expressions}}` (Expressions): Concrete value: Expression Sticker Pack; the visual directly delivers the case summary and expressions role
- `{{visual_style}}` (Visual Style): Illustration treatment focused on Avatar Expression, with polished execution, one focal point, and clear hierarchy
- `{{background_color}}` (Background Color): Natural skin tones and neutral wardrobe colors, with a muted cool background and soft warm rim light
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Make face identity, eye direction, expression, hairstyle, and crop unambiguous at small avatar size. Preserve natural facial structure and consistent color treatment; for an expression pack, vary only the requested emotion and keep the same face, wardrobe, lighting, camera angle, and background across every tile.
- For a series, lock the subject proportions, palette roles, lens language, and layout grammar before varying scene content. Every variation must remain recognizably in the same system.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

text.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「融资路演封面」创作图像：用强概念视觉与克制排版建立融资路演的第一印象。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{company_theme}}`（公司主题）：虚构且无商标的“融资路演封面”项目，品牌语气围绕企业、商业沟通、运营管理，不出现真实公司、Logo 或未经证实的主张
- `{{investment_stage}}`（投资阶段）：以“融资路演封面”作为具体取值；视觉内容直接落实为：用强概念视觉与克制排版建立融资路演的第一印象。

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 按完整产品界面处理：建立明确栅格、一个主行动按钮、可理解的组件状态与可信的信息密度。仅在需求明确时选择桌面端 16:9 或移动端 9:16。
- 建立一个主视觉或标题区、一个次级信息区与有意识的留白；缩略图状态下也必须先读出层级。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Create an investor pitch deck cover for {{company_theme}} at {{investment_stage}}. Use a confident abstract growth metaphor, elegant title-safe composition, and credible business polish. No readable text, no real logo, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{company_theme}}` (Company Theme): A fictional unbranded Investor Pitch Deck Cover project, positioned around Document Publishing, UI Interface without real companies, logos, or unsupported claims
- `{{investment_stage}}` (Investment Stage): Concrete value: Investor Pitch Deck Cover; the visual directly delivers the case summary and investment stage role
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Use a coherent product screen with a deliberate grid, one primary action, clear component states, and a realistic content density. Select 16:9 for desktop or 9:16 for mobile only when the brief specifies that platform.
- Establish one dominant visual or title zone, a secondary information zone, and intentional negative space. The composition must read at thumbnail size before adding detail.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

Respect {{platform_safe_zone}} and build the composition with {{campaign_palette}}, clean product separation, realistic material response, and a deliberate copy-safe area. The product must remain geometrically complete and immediately readable at thumbnail size. Portrait 2:3, one finished image, no platform UI, no generated copy, no second product, no people, no logo, and no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{campaign_product}}` (Campaign Product): One unbranded graphite streetwear sneaker with clearly separated mesh, leather overlays, and intact sculpted sole geometry
- `{{motion_element}}` (Motion Element): One electric-lime fabric ribbon forming a single S-curve around the shoe without hiding the toe, laces, or outsole silhouette
- `{{platform_safe_zone}}` (Platform Safe Zone): A portrait 2:3 frame with the upper 25% kept low-density, the product in the lower middle, and no platform buttons or interface chrome
- `{{campaign_palette}}` (Campaign Palette): 75% black and graphite, 15% brushed steel, and 10% electric lime restricted to the ribbon and small sole accents
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Preserve product geometry, material, and believable scale. Make the product the unambiguous hero; support it with controlled lighting, contact shadow, and copy-safe space rather than unrelated props.
- Design for mobile-first thumbnail reading with one focal message, declared platform-safe zones, and a restrained copy area. Do not generate fake platform chrome, engagement metrics, handles, or unrequested promotional text.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review product geometry, safe-zone spacing, and accidental branding before production use.

## 角色
你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「角色三视图」创作图像：为三维建模或系列插画提供稳定比例的角色三视图。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{character_concept}}`（角色概念）：角色三视图封面中的核心人物；身份与外观围绕角色设计、人物设定、IP 形象建立，并固定脸部、发型、服装和姿态识别点
- `{{costume_material}}`（服装材质）：保留自然皮肤纹理、真实发丝和有重量感的服装面料，首饰与装备只使用受控高光

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 保持人体、手部、服装逻辑与角色识别特征一致；姿势、表情、镜头和背景都必须服务同一身份。
- 系列工作流先锁定主体比例、色彩角色、镜头语言与版式语法，再变化场景内容；每张图都必须属于同一视觉系统。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。

Create a respectful, photorealistic close-up portrait of {{subject_description}} in {{setting}}. Use a head-and-shoulders composition only, with the face filling around 70% of the frame and both eyes in crisp focus. The subject wears {{wardrobe}}. Illuminate with soft directional daylight and a gentle warm bounce, creating dimensional cheekbones and a calm, direct expression. Show silver hair strands, fine lines, pores, natural age texture, and nuanced skin color with dignity; do not de-age or smooth the face. Keep the setting minimal and softly blurred so the person remains unmistakably central. Camera: 90mm lens at f/2.8, high-resolution editorial portrait photography, natural color rendering. No full body, no distant framing, no hands or objects in front of the face, no glamour retouching, no exaggerated wrinkles, no warped facial features, no text, no logo, no watermark.

你是一名资深视觉总监与图像制作设计师。请把需求转化为一张可交付的成品，而不是灵感拼贴。

## 核心任务
为案例「餐厅菜单封面」创作图像：用材质、色彩与留白建立餐厅菜单第一印象。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{cuisine_style}}`（菜系风格）：摄影表现，围绕餐饮、食物摄影、品牌内容建立高完成度、单一焦点和清晰层级
- `{{restaurant_mood}}`（餐厅氛围）：摄影表现，围绕餐饮、食物摄影、品牌内容建立高完成度、单一焦点和清晰层级

## 输出契约
- 只交付一张完成度高、可展示的最终图像；不要生成情绪板、九宫格、多方案展示板、过程稿、样机合集或互相竞争的版式。
- 先确定主焦点、次级信息层和留白，再补充细节；色板、光向、透视与材质行为必须统一。
- 不要虚构可读的品牌文案、商标、界面填充文字或水印。除非需求提供精确文案，否则文字区域仅作为受控占位。

## 成品结构
- 建立一个主视觉或标题区、一个次级信息区与有意识的留白；缩略图状态下也必须先读出层级。
- 保持商品几何、材质和尺度可信；商品必须是唯一焦点，用可控布光、接触阴影和文案留白替代无关道具。

## 质量门槛
- 输出前检查焦点层级、物理可信度、主体一致性、意外文字、重复对象、错误肢体和意外标志。
- 避免素材感填充、复制既有营销活动视觉、美术无关叠层、裁切错误和水印样痕迹。
- 已知限制：这是未经验证的起始案例；在实际生产使用前，请人工复核生成结果、文字与品牌合规性。
text.en:
Design a menu cover for a {{cuisine_style}} restaurant with a {{restaurant_mood}} mood. Use one refined food-or-material still life, elegant title space, and tactile print detail. Editorial hospitality design, no readable text, no watermark.

## Production protocol

### Brief integrity
- `{{cuisine_style}}` (Cuisine Style): Photography treatment focused on Product Commerce, Poster Editorial, with polished execution, one focal point, and clear hierarchy
- `{{restaurant_mood}}` (Restaurant Mood): Photography treatment focused on Product Commerce, Poster Editorial, with polished execution, one focal point, and clear hierarchy
- Keep the requested subject, use case, and visual hierarchy more important than generic style adjectives.

### Output contract
- Deliver one finished, presentation-ready image for this exact brief; do not create a moodboard, contact sheet, process sheet, mockup collection, or multiple competing layouts.
- Use one focal hierarchy, a restrained palette, coherent light direction, and enough negative space for the intended communication.
- Do not fabricate readable brand copy, trademarks, UI filler, or watermarks. Treat any text area as a controlled placeholder unless exact copy is supplied.

### Deliverable requirements
- Establish one dominant visual or title zone, a secondary information zone, and intentional negative space. The composition must read at thumbnail size before adding detail.
- Preserve product geometry, material, and believable scale. Make the product the unambiguous hero; support it with controlled lighting, contact shadow, and copy-safe space rather than unrelated props.

### Quality gate
- Before finalizing, check focal hierarchy, physical plausibility, subject consistency, unintended text, duplicate objects, broken anatomy, and accidental logos.
- Avoid stock-like filler, copied campaign aesthetics, unrelated overlays, framing errors, and watermark-like marks.
- Known limitation: Use the prompt as a starting point and review model output before production use.

prompt.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深图像艺术总监与制作设计师。请把需求转化为一个受控的最终视觉交付物，而不是松散的灵感板。

## 模板目标
产品研发拆解板：用结构、材料、使用情境和制造线索验证概念产品是否具备可信的研发逻辑。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{product}}`（产品）：请给出「产品」的具体对象、外形或功能、关键材质与不可改变的识别特征。
- `{{design_intent}}`（设计意图）：请填写「设计意图」的具体内容，至少包含对象或取值范围、一个可见特征，以及它对构图、信息层级或生成结果的影响。
- `{{key_components}}`（关键部件）：请填写「关键部件」的具体内容，至少包含对象或取值范围、一个可见特征，以及它对构图、信息层级或生成结果的影响。
- `{{materials}}`（材质）：请填写「材质」的具体内容，至少包含对象或取值范围、一个可见特征，以及它对构图、信息层级或生成结果的影响。
- `{{use_case}}`（使用案例）：请填写「使用案例」的具体内容，至少包含对象或取值范围、一个可见特征，以及它对构图、信息层级或生成结果的影响。

## 需求解析协议
- 每个变量都是生产决策。缺失字段必须先向需求方确认；不得静默替换为泛化商品、统计数据、品牌主张或人物身份。
- 在选择风格词前，先锁定交付类型、受众、画幅比例、焦点主体、信息密度和参考图保留要求。
- 如需求给出精确文案、源素材、尺寸或合规主张，将其作为受控输入保留，不得即兴改写。

## 输出契约
- 只生成一张完成的 product-commerce / document-publishing 成品；不要生成情绪板、多方案展示板、联系表、过程图、样机拼贴或没有解释的变体。
- 在添加视觉细节前，先建立主焦点、次级信息层与有意识的留白。
- 所有命名对象、视觉关系、镜头/透视逻辑和材质行为必须内部一致。

## 制作结构
- 建立一个主视觉或标题区、一个次级信息区与有意识的留白；缩略图状态下也必须先读出层级。
- 保持商品几何、材质和尺度可信；商品必须是唯一焦点，用可控布光、接触阴影和文案留白替代无关道具。
- 系列工作流先锁定主体比例、色彩角色、镜头语言与版式语法，再变化场景内容；每张图都必须属于同一视觉系统。

## 质量门槛
- 核心部件能与主产品一一对应
- 拆解顺序符合装配逻辑
- 材料和使用场景证明设计意图
- 先在缩略图尺度检查层级，再在完整尺寸检查事实准确性、文字可读性、几何、材质行为与参考图保留要求。

## 不可违反的约束
- 兼顾声明的模型兼容性，但始终以需求本身为最高优先级。
- 仅在需求提供精确短文案时才渲染文字；绝不虚构真实品牌、商标、没有来源的数据或填充文案。
- 输出前检查重复主体、不可能几何、冲突阴影、错误肢体、不可读微型文字与意外水印。

## 避免
- 不要把不可制造的细节当卖点
- 不要用密集标注掩盖结构缺失
prompt.en:
## Role
Act as a senior image art director and production designer. Convert the supplied brief into one controlled visual deliverable, not a loose inspiration board.

## Required brief fields
- `{{product}}` (Product): Provide the specific object, form or function, key materials, and non-negotiable identity features for Product.
- `{{design_intent}}` (Design Intent): Provide a concrete value for Design Intent, including the object or range, one visible characteristic, and its effect on composition, information hierarchy, or the generated result.
- `{{key_components}}` (Key Components): Provide a concrete value for Key Components, including the object or range, one visible characteristic, and its effect on composition, information hierarchy, or the generated result.
- `{{materials}}` (Materials): Provide a concrete value for Materials, including the object or range, one visible characteristic, and its effect on composition, information hierarchy, or the generated result.
- `{{use_case}}` (Use Case): Provide a concrete value for Use Case, including the object or range, one visible characteristic, and its effect on composition, information hierarchy, or the generated result.

## Brief-resolution protocol
- Treat every variable as a production decision. If a field is absent, request it before rendering; never silently substitute a generic product, statistic, brand claim, or identity.
- Lock deliverable, audience, aspect ratio, focal subject, information density, and reference-preservation requirements before choosing style adjectives.
- When exact copy, source assets, measurements, or legal claims are supplied, preserve them as controlled inputs rather than improvising replacements.

## Core task
Create a product-development explainer board for {{product}}. Translate {{design_intent}} into one centered hero render, a restrained exploded view of {{key_components}}, close material samples for {{materials}}, and one ergonomic or contextual proof for {{use_case}}. Show assembly order, contact points, seams, fasteners, thickness, and scale only where they make manufacturability more credible. Use a clean technical-editorial grid with short labels and consistent viewing angles. The board must explain how the product works as well as how it looks; do not replace structure with decorative concept art or invent unsupported specifications.

## Output contract
- Produce exactly one finished product-commerce / document-publishing deliverable. Do not create a moodboard, multi-option presentation board, contact sheet, process diagram, mockup collage, or unexplained variants.
- Establish a primary focal point, secondary information layer, and deliberate negative space before adding visual detail.
- Keep all named objects, visual relationships, camera/perspective logic, and material behavior internally consistent.

## Production structure
- Establish one dominant visual or title zone, a secondary information zone, and intentional negative space. The composition must read at thumbnail size before adding detail.
- Preserve product geometry, material, and believable scale. Make the product the unambiguous hero; support it with controlled lighting, contact shadow, and copy-safe space rather than unrelated props.
- For a series, lock the subject proportions, palette roles, lens language, and layout grammar before varying scene content. Every variation must remain recognizably in the same system.

## Quality gates
- Every required field is represented by a concrete, reviewable production decision.
- The Product Commerce / Document Publishing output has one clear focal hierarchy and remains readable at thumbnail size.
- Supplied copy, facts, geometry, subject identity, materials, and spatial relationships remain internally consistent.
- Review at thumbnail size first, then inspect factual accuracy, legibility, geometry, material behavior, and any reference-preservation requirement at full size.

## Non-negotiable constraints
- Respect the requested model compatibility, but prioritize the brief over any model-specific ornament.
- Use short, exact text only when the brief provides it; never invent a real brand, a trademark, unsupported statistics, or filler copy.
- Check for duplicate subjects, impossible geometry, incoherent shadows, broken anatomy, unreadable micro-text, and accidental watermarks before finalizing.

## Avoid
- Do not replace missing Text To Image / Series Consistency inputs with invented brands, statistics, identities, or filler copy.
- Do not add unrelated objects, competing layouts, unexplained variants, or decorative structure that weakens the requested outcome.
- Do not trade factual accuracy, legibility, physical plausibility, or subject consistency for surface-level style effects.

## 角色
你是一名资深图像艺术总监与制作设计师。请把需求转化为一个受控的最终视觉交付物，而不是松散的灵感板。

## 模板目标
产品落地页结构：从首屏到转化区，生成可读且层级清晰的产品官网页面。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{product_name}}`（产品名称）：请提供「产品名称」的准确文字；如不需要可读文字，请明确写“无文字”，不要让模型自行编写。
- `{{audience}}`（受众）：请说明「受众」对应的人群、使用情境和关注重点，使内容密度与表达方式可被准确判断。
- `{{value_proposition}}`（价值主张）：请填写「价值主张」的具体内容，至少包含对象或取值范围、一个可见特征，以及它对构图、信息层级或生成结果的影响。
- `{{visual_direction}}`（视觉方向）：请说明「视觉方向」的媒介、时代或审美方向、情绪强度与细节密度，并给出 1–2 个可见特征。
- `{{primary_cta}}`（主要行动按钮）：请填写「主要行动按钮」的具体内容，至少包含对象或取值范围、一个可见特征，以及它对构图、信息层级或生成结果的影响。

## 需求解析协议
- 每个变量都是生产决策。缺失字段必须先向需求方确认；不得静默替换为泛化商品、统计数据、品牌主张或人物身份。
- 在选择风格词前，先锁定交付类型、受众、画幅比例、焦点主体、信息密度和参考图保留要求。
- 如需求给出精确文案、源素材、尺寸或合规主张，将其作为受控输入保留，不得即兴改写。

## 输出契约
- 只生成一张完成的 ui-interface 成品；不要生成情绪板、多方案展示板、联系表、过程图、样机拼贴或没有解释的变体。
- 在添加视觉细节前，先建立主焦点、次级信息层与有意识的留白。
- 所有命名对象、视觉关系、镜头/透视逻辑和材质行为必须内部一致。

## 制作结构
- 按完整产品界面处理：建立明确栅格、一个主行动按钮、可理解的组件状态与可信的信息密度。仅在需求明确时选择桌面端 16:9 或移动端 9:16。

## 质量门槛

prompt.zh:
## 角色
你是一名资深图像艺术总监与制作设计师。请把需求转化为一个受控的最终视觉交付物，而不是松散的灵感板。

## 模板目标
分镜叙事板：以镜头顺序、情绪节奏和关键动作组织一段视觉故事。

## 必填需求字段
- `{{story}}`（故事）：请写明「故事」发生了什么、谁在行动、动作结果或情绪转折是什么，确保画面有单一可读节点。
- `{{protagonist}}`（主角）：请定义「主角」的身份、外观识别点、服装或姿态，以及必须在系列中保持不变的锚点。
- `{{setting}}`（场景）：请明确「场景」的地点、时间、空间尺度、关键环境元素及其与主体的关系。
- `{{emotion_arc}}`（情绪弧线）：请填写「情绪弧线」的具体内容，至少包含对象或取值范围、一个可见特征，以及它对构图、信息层级或生成结果的影响。
- `{{visual_style}}`（视觉风格）：请说明「视觉风格」的媒介、时代或审美方向、情绪强度与细节密度，并给出 1–2 个可见特征。

## 需求解析协议
- 每个变量都是生产决策。缺失字段必须先向需求方确认；不得静默替换为泛化商品、统计数据、品牌主张或人物身份。
- 在选择风格词前，先锁定交付类型、受众、画幅比例、焦点主体、信息密度和参考图保留要求。
- 如需求给出精确文案、源素材、尺寸或合规主张，将其作为受控输入保留，不得即兴改写。

## 输出契约
- 只生成一张完成的 scene-storytelling 成品；不要生成情绪板、多方案展示板、联系表、过程图、样机拼贴或没有解释的变体。
- 在添加视觉细节前，先建立主焦点、次级信息层与有意识的留白。
- 所有命名对象、视觉关系、镜头/透视逻辑和材质行为必须内部一致。

## 制作结构
- 通过前景、中景、远景和明确动作讲清叙事节点；系列中人物、道具和世界规则必须连续。

- 每格都有明确动作或转折
- 景别变化服务节奏
- 人物服装和道具连续
- 先在缩略图尺度检查层级，再在完整尺寸检查事实准确性、文字可读性、几何、材质行为与参考图保留要求。

- 兼顾声明的模型兼容性，但始终以需求本身为最高优先级。

- 不要把六格都画成同一景别
- 不要跳过故事因果关系

- `{{setting}}` (Setting): Specify the place, time, scale, key environmental elements, and their relationship to the subject for Setting.
- `{{emotion_arc}}` (Emotion Arc): Provide a concrete value for Emotion Arc, including the object or range, one visible characteristic, and its effect on composition, information hierarchy, or the generated result.
- `{{visual_style}}` (Visual Style): Describe the medium, era or aesthetic direction, emotional intensity, detail density, and 1–2 visible cues for Visual Style.

## Brief-resolution protocol
- Treat every variable as a production decision. If a field is absent, request it before rendering; never silently substitute a generic product, statistic, brand claim, or identity.

## Core task
Create a six-panel storyboard for {{story}}. Follow {{protagonist}} through {{setting}} with an emotional arc of {{emotion_arc}}. Use {{visual_style}}. Vary shot size deliberately, preserve character continuity, label each beat briefly, and make cause-and-effect readable without dialogue.

## Output contract
- Produce exactly one finished scene-storytelling deliverable. Do not create a moodboard, multi-option presentation board, contact sheet, process diagram, mockup collage, or unexplained variants.
- Establish a primary focal point, secondary information layer, and deliberate negative space before adding visual detail.
- Keep all named objects, visual relationships, camera/perspective logic, and material behavior internally consistent.

## Production structure
- Make the narrative beat legible through foreground, midground, background, and a clear focal action. Maintain continuity of subject, props, and world rules across any sequence.
- For a series, lock the subject proportions, palette roles, lens language, and layout grammar before varying scene content. Every variation must remain recognizably in the same system.

## Quality gates
- Every required field is represented by a concrete, reviewable production decision.
- The Scene Storytelling output has one clear focal hierarchy and remains readable at thumbnail size.
- Supplied copy, facts, geometry, subject identity, materials, and spatial relationships remain internally consistent.
- Review at thumbnail size first, then inspect factual accuracy, legibility, geometry, material behavior, and any reference-preservation requirement at full size.

## Non-negotiable constraints
- Respect the requested model compatibility, but prioritize the brief over any model-specific ornament.
- Use short, exact text only when the brief provides it; never invent a real brand, a trademark, unsupported statistics, or filler copy.
- Check for duplicate subjects, impossible geometry, incoherent shadows, broken anatomy, unreadable micro-text, and accidental watermarks before finalizing.

## Avoid
- Do not replace missing Text To Image / Series Consistency inputs with invented brands, statistics, identities, or filler copy.
- Do not add unrelated objects, competing layouts, unexplained variants, or decorative structure that weakens the requested outcome.
- Do not trade factual accuracy, legibility, physical plausibility, or subject consistency for surface-level style effects.
